name: MaskPad
game: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (N64) via 2 Ship 2 Harkinian

inputs.description: Your own supported Majora's Mask ROM, copied into the app's Files folder after installation. The build does not read it.

tools.name: cmake
tools.note: Install CMake 3.26 or newer: brew install cmake

tools.name: pkgconf
tools.note: brew install pkgconf (see README for the full Homebrew list)

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform (Command Line Tools alone are not enough). Complete first-launch setup, then select Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iOS SDK
tools.note: Install full Xcode and its iOS platform (Command Line Tools alone are not enough). Complete first-launch setup, then select Xcode in Xcode > Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools.

publication.reason: The app is compiled from the 2 Ship 2 Harkinian decompilation; public releases are source only.
